exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'Dos and Don'ts'
  = Qilinadigan va qilinmaydigan ishlar

  Bu — FE'LDAN yasalgan OT birikmasi:
     do    (qilmoq)    →  DOS    (qilinadigan
                                  ishlar)
     don't (qilma)     →  DON'TS (qilinmaydigan
                                  ishlar)

  Qoidalar ro'yxati uchun ishlatiladi:
     'the dos and don'ts of recycling'
     (qayta ishlashning qoidalari)


UNIT 14 NING ASOSIY MAVZULARI
(4-modul muqovasidan):
  • the environment   (atrof-muhit)
  • tips & rules      (maslahat va qoidalar)


GRAMMATIKASI — MODAL FE'LLAR:
  SHOULD / SHOULDN'T  →  maslahat
  MUST / MUSTN'T      →  majburiyat / taqiq
  CAN / CAN'T         →  ruxsat


BETDAGI RASM:
  Butun bet fonida QARAG'AYZOR o'rmon —
  unitning ekologik mavzusiga ishora.
  Chap tomonda o'rmonning KESILGAN qismi ham
  ko'rinadi.


BOG'LIQLIK — OLDINGI BETLAR:
  • Coursebook 88-89-bet (The Expedition,
    2-epizod) — tropik o'rmonni himoya qilish
  • Coursebook 97-bet, 14-mashq — 30 yildan
    keyingi ifloslanish, kislorod niqoblari
  Ikkalasi ham shu unitga tayyorgarlik edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  dos and don'ts = qilinadigan va qilinmaydigan
                   ishlar
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  a tip          = maslahat
  a rule         = qoida

exercises.instructionEn: Read the statements a to e. Which refers to: health? house rules? the environment? travel? school?
exercises.instructionUz: a dan e gacha bo'lgan gaplarni o'qing. Qaysi biri quyidagilarga tegishli: sog'liq? uy qoidalari? atrof-muhit? sayohat? maktab?
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh MAVZU:
  health?            (sog'liq)
  house rules?       (uy qoidalari)
  the environment?   (atrof-muhit)
  travel?            (sayohat)
  school?            (maktab)

BESh GAP:
  a  Use buses and trams — not cars.
  b  Always have your passport with you.
  c  Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.
  d  Don't keep pets in your room.
  e  Never eat in class.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  a  →  THE ENVIRONMENT  (atrof-muhit)
  b  →  TRAVEL           (sayohat)
  c  →  HEALTH           (sog'liq)
  d  →  HOUSE RULES      (uy qoidalari)
  e  →  SCHOOL           (maktab)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a  Avtobus va tramvaydan foydalaning —
     mashinadan emas.
  b  Doim pasportingizni yoningizda olib yuring.
  c  Ko'p meva va sabzavot yeng.
  d  Xonangizda uy hayvonlarini saqlamang.
  e  Sinfda hech qachon ovqat yemang.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  a  'buses and trams — NOT CARS'
     → jamoat transporti mashinadan ko'ra
       kamroq ifloslantiradi
     → ATROF-MUHIT

  b  'PASSPORT'
     → pasport faqat chet elga chiqishda kerak
     → SAYOHAT

  c  'FRUIT AND VEGETABLES'
     → to'g'ri ovqatlanish
     → SOG'LIQ

  d  'in your ROOM', 'PETS'
     → uydagi tartib
     → UY QOIDALARI

  e  'in CLASS'
     → sinfdagi tartib
     → MAKTAB


DIQQAT — GAPLARNING ShAKLLARI:

  BUYRUQ (tasdiq) — nima QILISh kerak:
     'USE buses and trams'
     'HAVE your passport'
     'EAT lots of fruit'

  BUYRUQ (inkor) — nima QILMASLIK kerak:
     'DON'T KEEP pets in your room'
     'NEVER EAT in class'

  Bu — unitning nomi: DOS (a, b, c) va
  DON'TS (d, e).


DIQQAT — 'NEVER' va 'DON'T':
  'DON'T eat in class.'   — oddiy taqiq
  'NEVER eat in class.'   — KUChLIROQ taqiq
  'never' buyruq gapda 'don't' o'rniga keladi
  va ma'noni kuchaytiradi.


QO'ShIMChA SAVOL:
  'Can you think of any more DOS and DON'TS for
   each subject?'
  (Har bir mavzu uchun yana qoidalar o'ylab
   topa olasizmi?)

  NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  ATROF-MUHIT:
     Recycle paper and glass.
     Don't throw rubbish in the street.
     Turn off the lights when you leave a room.

  SAYOHAT:
     Book your tickets early.
     Don't carry a lot of money with you.

  SOG'LIQ:
     Do exercise every day.
     Don't eat too much sugar.

  UY QOIDALARI:
     Tidy your room every day.
     Don't play loud music at night.

  MAKTAB:
     Always do your homework.
     Don't be late for class.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a tram       = tramvay
  a passport   = pasport
  to keep pets = uy hayvonlarini saqlamoq
  in class     = sinfda (artikl YO'Q)
  a subject    = mavzu; fan

SAKKIZ RASM (A-H), O'N BAND.
Demak BA'ZI rasmlar BIR NEChA marta ishlatiladi.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  A  Qarag'ayzor o'rmon (chapda kesilgan qismi
     ham bor)
  B  To'lib ketgan simto'r axlat qutisi;
     ustida plastik shishalar va bankalar,
     atrofda sochilib yotgan axlat
  C  Plastik idishlarda o'ralgan go'sht
  D  'RECYCLE' yozuvli kulrang g'ildirakli quti
  E  Shahar ko'chasidagi qizil-oq tramvay
  F  'SUPER BUBBLES' yozuvli uchta sariq
     idish-tovoq yuvish suyuqligi
  G  Ochilgan konserva bankasi
  H  'INSECT REPELLENT' yozuvli aerozol balloni


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  pre-packaged food     →  C
   2  washing-up liquid     →  F
   3  an aluminium can      →  G
   4  a recycling bin       →  D
   5  public transport      →  E
   6  rubbish               →  B
   7  a forest              →  A
   8  plastic bottles       →  B
   9  an aerosol can        →  H
  10  a rubbish bin         →  B


DIQQAT — 'B' RASMI UCh MARTA:
  Bu rasm bir vaqtning o'zida uchta narsani
  ko'rsatadi:
     • AXLAT QUTISI (rubbish bin) — simto'r quti
     • AXLAT (rubbish) — atrofda sochilgan
     • PLASTIK ShIShALAR (plastic bottles) —
       qutining ustida

  Shuning uchun 6, 8 va 10-bandlar hammasi B.


DIQQAT — 'D' va 'B' FARQI:
  B  — oddiy AXLAT QUTISI (rubbish bin),
        to'lib ketgan, atrofi iflos
  D  — QAYTA IShLASh QUTISI (recycling bin),
        ustida 'RECYCLE' yozuvi, toza

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini bergan —
  farqi MUHIM: biri chiqindi, biri qayta ishlash.


DIQQAT — 'F' va 'B' DAGI ShIShALAR:
  F  — idish yuvish suyuqligi idishlari
        (yangi, ishlatilayotgan)
  B  — tashlab yuborilgan plastik shishalar
        (chiqindi)

  2-band → F (washing-up liquid — mahsulot nomi)
  8-band → B (plastic bottles — chiqindi sifatida)


DIQQAT — 'G' va 'H' FARQI:
  G  — ALUMINIY BANKA (aluminium can) —
        konserva bankasi, QAYTA IShLASh mumkin
  H  — AEROZOL BALLONI (aerosol can) —
        ozon qatlamiga ZARAR beradi

  Ikkalasi ham 'can' deyiladi, lekin BUTUNLAY
  boshqa narsa!


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (ikkinchi qism):
  'I can see A FOREST in picture A.'

  QOLIP:
     'I can see + [narsa] + in picture + [harf].'

  washing-up liquid = idish yuvish suyuqligi
  aluminium         = alyuminiy
  a can             = banka; ballon

TO'RT JUFTLIK — har birida bittasi ATROF-MUHITGA
FOYDALI, ikkinchisi ZARARLI maslahat.

DIQQAT — AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Unit mavzusi 'the environment' — demak DOIM
  ekologik jihatdan TO'G'RI variant tanlanadi.
  Har juftlikda bittasi ochiq-oydin zararli.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  a)  Try NOT to buy pre-packaged food.
  2  b)  NEVER light fires in forests.
  3  a)  DO NOT throw plastic bottles into the sea.
  4  b)  DO NOT use aerosols.

  Ya'ni: a, b, a, b


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka
     harakat qiling.
  2  O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang.
  3  Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang.
  4  Aerozollardan foydalanmang.


HAR BIRI NEGA — EKOLOGIK ASOS:

  1  PRE-PACKAGED FOOD (o'ralgan ovqat)
     Har bir o'ram — plastik CHIQINDI.
     Ochiq sotiladigan mahsulot kamroq chiqindi
     hosil qiladi.
     → 'Try NOT to buy' (a)

  2  FIRES IN FORESTS (o'rmonda olov)
     Olov o'rmon YONG'INIGA sabab bo'ladi —
     minglab daraxt va hayvon nobud bo'ladi.
     → 'NEVER light fires' (b)

  3  PLASTIC BOTTLES INTO THE SEA
     Plastik dengizda yuzlab yil chiriydi,
     baliq va qushlar halok bo'ladi.
     → 'DO NOT throw' (a)

  4  AEROSOLS (aerozollar)
     Aerozollardagi gazlar OZON qatlamini
     yemiradi.
     → 'DO NOT use aerosols' (b)


NAQSh — JAVOB TARTIBI:
  1  a  (inkor variant BIRINChI)
  2  b  (inkor variant IKKINChI)
  3  a  (inkor variant BIRINChI)
  4  b  (inkor variant IKKINChI)

  Ya'ni HAR DOIM INKOR variant to'g'ri —
  faqat uning o'rni almashib turadi.
  Kitob ataylab shunday qilgan, toki o'quvchi
  'a' yoki 'b' ni yodlab olmasin.


UCh XIL INKOR ShAKLI:
  'TRY NOT TO buy ...'   — yumshoq maslahat
  'NEVER light ...'      — qat'iy taqiq
  'DO NOT throw ...'     — taqiq
  'DO NOT use ...'       — taqiq

  'try not to + fe'l' = ... qilmaslikka harakat
  qilmoq (eng yumshoq shakl).


DIQQAT — 'LIGHT A FIRE':
  'to LIGHT a fire' = olov yoqmoq.
  light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
  Workbook 54-betda ham bor edi:
  'matches → to light a campfire'.


BOG'LIQLIK — 2-MAShQ BILAN:
  Har bir band 2-mashqdagi rasmga to'g'ri keladi:
     1  →  C  (pre-packaged food)
     2  →  A  (a forest)
     3  →  B  (plastic bottles)
     4  →  H  (an aerosol can)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to light a fire = olov yoqmoq
  to throw        = tashlamoq
  into the sea    = dengizga
  an aerosol      = aerozol
  try not to      = ... qilmaslikka harakat qilmoq

exercises.instructionUz: ATROF-MUHITGA YORDAM BERISH — varaqa matni
exercises.explanationUz:
VARAQANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI

Sarlavha:
  HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT
  (Atrof-muhitga yordam berish)

Kirish:
  'There are a lot of things we can do to
   PROTECT the environment.'
  (Atrof-muhitni HIMOYA QILISH uchun
   qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.)


SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA:

 1  Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
    The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
    → Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka
      harakat qiling. O'ram ko'p axlat hosil
      qiladi.

 2  Use less washing-up liquid.
    It pollutes the seas and rivers.
    → Idish yuvish suyuqligidan KAMROQ
      foydalaning. U dengiz va daryolarni
      ifloslantiradi.

 3  Put aluminium cans into recycling bins.
    Factories can use them to make new things.
    → Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash
      qutisiga soling. Zavodlar ulardan yangi
      narsalar yasashi mumkin.

 4  Use public transport (i.e. buses, trains,
    trams, etc). Cars pollute the air.
    → Jamoat transportidan foydalaning (ya'ni
      avtobus, poyezd, tramvay va h.k.).
      Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.

 5  Never light fires in forests.
    Trees will burn.
    → O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang.
      Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.

 6  Do not drop rubbish in the street.
    It looks and smells horrible.
    Use rubbish bins.
    → Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang. U dahshatli
      ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.
      Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.

 7  Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea.
    Fish will die.
    → Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang.
      Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.

 8  Do not use aerosols.
    They pollute the air.
    → Aerozollardan foydalanmang.
      Ular havoni ifloslantiradi.


MATNNING TUZILIShI — HAR BANDDA IKKI GAP:

   1-gap:  KO'RSATMA  (buyruq)
   2-gap:  SABAB      (nima uchun)

  Masalan:
     KO'RSATMA:  'Try not to buy pre-packaged food.'
     SABAB:      'The packaging creates a lot of
                  rubbish.'

  Bu — 4b-mashqning kaliti: har bir savolning
  javobi IKKINCHI gap.


UCh XIL BUYRUQ ShAKLI VARAQADA:

  TASDIQ (nima qilish kerak) — 2 ta:
     'USE less washing-up liquid.'
     'PUT aluminium cans into recycling bins.'
     'USE public transport.'
     'USE rubbish bins.'

  YUMShOQ INKOR — 1 ta:
     'TRY NOT TO buy pre-packaged food.'

  QAT'IY INKOR — 4 ta:
     'NEVER light fires in forests.'
     'DO NOT drop rubbish in the street.'
     'DO NOT throw plastic bottles into the sea.'
     'DO NOT use aerosols.'


DIQQAT — SABABLARDA 'WILL':
  'Trees WILL burn.'   (Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.)
  'Fish WILL die.'     (Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.)

  Bu — Unit 13 da o'rganilgan WILL:
  DALILGA asoslanmagan, lekin ishonchli BASHORAT.
  Ya'ni: agar shunday qilsang, natijasi shu bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'I.E.':
  'public transport (I.E. buses, trains, trams)'
  i.e. = lotincha 'id est' = ya'ni
  Misol keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.
  O'qilishi: 'that is' yoki harflab 'ai-i'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: The leaflet says, 'Try not to buy
      pre-packaged food.' WHY?
  SB: BECAUSE the packaging creates a lot of
      rubbish.

  QOLIP:
     SAVOL:  The leaflet says, '...'. Why?
     JAVOB:  Because + [sabab gapi].


BARCHA SABABLAR:

 1  Try not to buy pre-packaged food. WHY?
    → BECAUSE the packaging creates a lot of
      rubbish.

 2  Use less washing-up liquid. WHY?
    → BECAUSE it pollutes the seas and rivers.

 3  Put aluminium cans into recycling bins. WHY?
    → BECAUSE factories can use them to make
      new things.

 4  Use public transport. WHY?
    → BECAUSE cars pollute the air.

 5  Never light fires in forests. WHY?
    → BECAUSE trees will burn.

 6  Do not drop rubbish in the street. WHY?
    → BECAUSE it looks and smells horrible.

 7  Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea.
    WHY?
    → BECAUSE fish will die.

 8  Do not use aerosols. WHY?
    → BECAUSE they pollute the air.


QANDAY TOPILADI — JUDA ODDIY QOIDA:
  Har bandda IKKI gap bor.
     1-gap = KO'RSATMA
     2-gap = SABAB
  Demak javob DOIM ikkinchi gap.
  Faqat oldiga 'BECAUSE' qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE' DAN KEYIN:
  'Because the packaging CREATES ...'
  'Because it POLLUTES ...'

  Sabab gapida EGA + FE'L bo'lishi SHART.
  'Because of' — bundan farq qiladi:
     because + EGA + FE'L
     because of + OT

  'Because it pollutes the sea.'  ✓
  'Because of pollution.'         ✓
  'Because of it pollutes.'       ✗


DIQQAT — SABABLARDA IKKI XIL ZAMON:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy haqiqat) — 5 ta:
     'the packaging CREATES ...'
     'it POLLUTES ...'
     'factories CAN USE ...'
     'cars POLLUTE ...'
     'it LOOKS and SMELLS ...'
     'they POLLUTE ...'

  WILL (natija bashorati) — 2 ta:
     'trees WILL BURN'
     'fish WILL DIE'

  Farqi: birinchi guruh HOZIR ham shunday;
  ikkinchi guruh — AGAR qilsang, KEYIN shunday
  bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'the leaflet SAYS':
  'to say' fe'li matn/kitob/e'lon uchun
  ishlatiladi:
     'The leaflet says ...'
     'The sign says ...'
     'The book says ...'
  ('The leaflet TELLS' — XATO. 'tell' ga
   ODAM kerak: 'tell ME'.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a leaflet   = varaqa, buklet
  a reason    = sabab
  packaging   = o'ram (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  to pollute  = ifloslantirmoq
  a factory   = zavod
  to burn     = yonmoq
  to die      = nobud bo'lmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  'The first thing you should remember when in
   England is always to say "please" and
   "thank you". Never push into a queue of
   people or they'll get angry. Don't be late
   for appointments and don't talk with your
   mouth full. Remember — always ask before
   smoking in someone's house.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Angliyada eslab qolish kerak bo'lgan
   birinchi narsa — doim "iltimos" va
   "rahmat" deyish. Odamlar navbatiga hech
   qachon suqilib kirmang, aks holda ular
   jahli chiqadi. Uchrashuvlarga kechikmang
   va og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmang.
   Esda tuting — birovning uyida chekishdan
   oldin doim ruxsat so'rang.'


ANGLIYADAGI TO'RT QOIDA:
  1  Always say 'please' and 'thank you'.
  2  Never push into a queue.
  3  Don't be late for appointments.
  4  Don't talk with your mouth full.
  5  Always ask before smoking in someone's
     house.


RASM:
  Big Ben (Vestminster soati) va qizil
  ikki qavatli avtobus — Londonning eng mashhur
  ikki ramzi.


DIQQAT — 'A QUEUE':
  queue = navbat (odamlar qatori)
  O'qilishi: /kyu/ — faqat BIRINCHI harf
  o'qiladi, qolgan 'ueue' JIM!

  Britaniyada navbat — juda muhim madaniy
  qoida. 'to push into a queue' = navbatga
  suqilib kirmoq (juda qo'pol harakat).

  Amerikada 'a line' deyiladi.


DIQQAT — 'OR THEY'LL GET ANGRY':
  Bu yerdagi 'OR' = 'aks holda'.
     'Don't do it OR you'll be sorry.'
     (Buni qilmang, AKS HOLDA afsuslanasiz.)

  'they'll get angry' — WILL bilan natija
  bashorati (Unit 13 dan).
  'to GET angry' = jahli chiqmoq
  ('to BE angry' = jahli chiqqan bo'lmoq —
   holat, harakat emas).


DIQQAT — 'WITH YOUR MOUTH FULL':
  So'zma-so'z: 'og'zingiz to'la holda'.
  Bu — 'with + OT + SIFAT' qurilmasi:
     with your mouth full
     with your eyes closed
     with the door open


DIQQAT — 'THE FIRST THING ... IS TO SAY':
  'The first thing you should remember IS
   always TO SAY ...'
  Ega — 'the first thing', kesim — 'is',
  keyin TO-INFINITIVE.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a queue          = navbat (o'qilishi /kyu/)
  to push into     = suqilib kirmoq
  to get angry     = jahli chiqmoq
  an appointment   = uchrashuv (belgilangan)
  with your mouth full = og'zi to'la holda
  to smoke         = chekmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  'When in China, don't kiss anyone in public —
   it's very rude. Never be late for
   appointments, and don't tell jokes to people
   you don't know very well. Be careful when you
   are eating, too — never leave your chopsticks
   pointing upwards in your rice because this
   makes people very upset. A last tip — when
   you give someone a present, give it with both
   hands.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Xitoyda odamlar oldida hech kimni
   o'pmang — bu juda qo'pol. Uchrashuvlarga
   hech qachon kechikmang va yaxshi
   tanimaydigan odamlarga hazil aytmang.
   Ovqatlanayotganda ham ehtiyot bo'ling —
   guruchingizga tayoqchalarni tik qilib
   sanchib qo'ymang, chunki bu odamlarni juda
   xafa qiladi. Oxirgi maslahat — birovga
   sovg'a berayotganingizda, uni IKKI QO'LLAB
   bering.'


XITOYDAGI BESH QOIDA:
  1  Don't kiss anyone in public.
  2  Never be late for appointments.
  3  Don't tell jokes to people you don't know
     well.
  4  Never leave your chopsticks pointing
     upwards in your rice.
  5  Give a present with both hands.


RASM:
  Pekindagi Taqiqlangan shahar (Gugong)
  darvozasi — an'anaviy xitoy me'morchiligi.


DIQQAT — TAYOQChALAR QOIDASI:
  'never leave your chopsticks pointing
   UPWARDS in your rice'

  Nega? Guruchga TIK sanchilgan tayoqchalar
  marhumlar uchun qo'yiladigan tutatqiga
  o'xshaydi — shuning uchun juda yomon belgi
  hisoblanadi.

  Matn buni 'this makes people very UPSET'
  deb tushuntiradi.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE + kishi + SIFAT':
  'This MAKES people very UPSET.'
  (Bu odamlarni juda xafa QILADI.)

  Qurilma:  make + [kim] + [sifat]
     It makes me happy.
     It made him angry.

  'to' YO'Q: 'makes people TO be upset' — XATO.


DIQQAT — 'TELL JOKES':
  'TELL a joke'  ✓  (hazil aytmoq)
  'SAY a joke'   ✗

  'tell' bilan keladiganlar:
     tell a joke, tell a story, tell a lie,
     tell the truth


DIQQAT — 'PEOPLE YOU DON'T KNOW VERY WELL':
  So'zma-so'z: 'siz yaxshi tanimaydigan odamlar'.
  Bu yerda 'who/that' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN:
     people (WHO) you don't know very well
  Ergash gapda 'who' to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa,
  tushirib qoldirish mumkin.


DIQQAT — 'IN PUBLIC':
  'in public' = odamlar oldida, ochiqchasiga
  Artikl YO'Q — turg'un ibora.
  ('in the public' — boshqa ma'no)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  rude          = qo'pol, odobsiz
  in public     = odamlar oldida
  to tell jokes = hazil aytmoq
  chopsticks    = (xitoy) tayoqchalar
  upwards       = yuqoriga qarab
  upset         = xafa, ko'ngli buzilgan
  a present     = sovg'a
  with both hands = ikki qo'llab

exercises.instructionEn: JAPAN — the text
exercises.instructionUz: YAPONIYA — matn
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  'When you visit someone in Japan, it is polite
   to take a gift. Remember to take your shoes
   off as you enter the house — they will give
   you special slippers to wear instead. Leave
   your shoes at the door, but make sure the
   toes are pointing towards the door. When you
   are in the living-room, don't sit anywhere
   you like — wait until someone shows you where
   to sit. Also, don't blow your nose in public —
   find a place where you can do it alone.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Yaponiyada birovnikiga borganingizda,
   sovg'a olib borish odobdan. Uyga
   kirayotganingizda oyoq kiyimingizni yechishni
   unutmang — ular sizga o'rniga maxsus
   shippak berishadi. Oyoq kiyimingizni
   eshik oldida qoldiring, lekin uchlari
   ESHIKKA QARAB turganiga ishonch hosil
   qiling. Mehmonxonada bo'lganingizda,
   xohlagan joyingizga o'tirmang — kimdir
   sizga qayerga o'tirishni ko'rsatgunicha
   kuting. Yana, odamlar oldida burningizni
   qoqmang — buni yolg'iz qila oladigan joy
   toping.'


YAPONIYADAGI BESH QOIDA:
  1  Take a gift when you visit someone.
  2  Take your shoes off as you enter the house.
  3  Make sure the toes point towards the door.
  4  Don't sit anywhere you like — wait until
     someone shows you where to sit.
  5  Don't blow your nose in public.


RASM:
  An'anaviy kimono va soch bezaklaridagi
  yapon ayollari (geysha).


DIQQAT — OYOQ KIYIM QOIDASI:
  Yaponiyada uyga oyoq kiyimda kirilmaydi.
  Uy egasi SHIPPAK (slippers) beradi.
  Oyoq kiyimning UCHLARI eshikka qaratib
  qo'yiladi — chiqishda oson kiyish uchun.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE OFF' — AJRALADIGAN FE'L:
  'take your shoes OFF'  ✓
  'take OFF your shoes'  ✓
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

  LEKIN olmosh bilan FAQAT o'rtada:
     'take them OFF'      ✓
     'take OFF them'      ✗


DIQQAT — 'MAKE SURE':
  'MAKE SURE the toes are pointing ...'
  = ishonch hosil qiling, tekshiring

  Qurilma: make sure (that) + [to'liq gap]


DIQQAT — 'IT IS POLITE TO + fe'l':
  'It is POLITE TO TAKE a gift.'
  (Sovg'a olib borish odobdan.)

  Qurilma: It is + SIFAT + TO + fe'l
     It's rude to point at people.
     It's important to be on time.


DIQQAT — 'AS YOU ENTER':
  Bu yerdagi 'AS' = 'when' (payt).
     'as you enter the house'
     = uyga kirayotganingizda


DIQQAT — 'TO WEAR INSTEAD':
  'special slippers TO WEAR' — MAQSAD
  ('kiyish uchun maxsus shippak')
  'INSTEAD' = o'rniga (gap oxirida turadi)


DIQQAT — 'BLOW YOUR NOSE':
  'to blow your nose' = burnini qoqmoq
  (so'zma-so'z: 'burniga puflamoq')
  Yaponiyada bu odamlar oldida qo'pol
  hisoblanadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  polite        = odobli
  a gift        = sovg'a
  to take off   = yechmoq
  to enter      = kirmoq
  slippers      = shippak
  instead       = o'rniga
  to make sure  = ishonch hosil qilmoq
  a toe         = oyoq barmog'i; (kiyim) uchi
  towards       = ... tomon
  the living-room = mehmonxona
  to blow your nose = burnini qoqmoq
  alone         = yolg'iz

exercises.instructionEn: The statements from 1 to 12 are tips for visitors to England, China and Japan. Read the statements (1-12) and explain the words in bold, then guess which country each statement is for. Write J (for Japan), E (for England) or C (for China). Finally, read the texts and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: 1 dan 12 gacha bo'lgan gaplar — Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaga boruvchilar uchun maslahatlar. Gaplarni o'qing, qalin harfdagi so'zlarni tushuntiring, so'ngra har biri qaysi mamlakat uchun ekanini toping. J (Yaponiya), E (Angliya) yoki C (Xitoy) deb yozing. Oxirida matnlarni o'qib, javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  E  (kitobda NAMUNA sifatida berilgan)
   2  J
   3  J
   4  C
   5  E
   6  J
   7  C
   8  E
   9  J
  10  E va C   (IKKI katakcha bor!)
  11  C
  12  E


MAMLAKATLAR BO'YIChA:

  ANGLIYA (E) — 5 ta:
     1  Ask before smoking in someone's house.
     5  Always say 'please' and 'thank you'.
     8  Never push into a queue of people.
    10  Don't be late for appointments.
    12  Don't talk with your mouth full.

  XITOY (C) — 4 ta:
     4  Don't kiss anyone in public.
     7  Never leave your chopsticks pointing
        upwards in your rice.
    10  Don't be late for appointments.
    11  Don't tell jokes to people you don't
        know well.

  YAPONIYA (J) — 4 ta:
     2  When you visit someone, take a gift
        with you.
     3  Take your shoes off as you enter the
        house.
     6  Don't blow your nose in public.
     9  Make sure the toes of your shoes are
        pointing towards the door.


DIQQAT — 10-BAND IKKI JAVOBLI:
  Kitobda 10-bandda IKKITA katakcha bosilgan:
     '10 Don't be late for appointments.
         ............., ............'

  Chunki bu qoida IKKI matnda ham bor:
     ANGLIYA: 'Don't be late for appointments'
     XITOY:   'Never be late for appointments'

  Javob: E va C.


DIQQAT — 'IN PUBLIC' IKKI MARTA:
  4-band: 'Don't KISS anyone in public.'  → C
  6-band: 'Don't BLOW YOUR NOSE in public.' → J

  Ikkalasida ham 'in public' bor, lekin
  HARAKAT boshqa. Faqat matnni o'qib ajratish
  mumkin:
     Xitoy matni — 'don't KISS anyone in public'
     Yaponiya matni — 'don't BLOW YOUR NOSE
                      in public'


QALIN HARFDAGI SO'ZLAR — TUShUNTIRISh:

  a GIFT = sovg'a
     'a present' bilan bir xil ma'no.

  TAKE YOUR SHOES OFF = oyoq kiyimni yechmoq
     'take off' — ajraladigan fe'l.

  to KISS = o'pmoq

  IN PUBLIC = odamlar oldida, ochiqchasiga
     Artikl YO'Q — turg'un ibora.

  BLOW YOUR NOSE = burnini qoqmoq
     So'zma-so'z: 'burniga puflamoq'.

  CHOPSTICKS POINTING UPWARDS
     = yuqoriga qaragan tayoqchalar
     chopsticks — xitoy/yapon ovqat tayoqchalari
     to point — ko'rsatmoq, qaramoq
     upwards — yuqoriga qarab

  to PUSH INTO A QUEUE = navbatga suqilib kirmoq
     queue — navbat (o'qilishi /kyu/)

  the TOES OF YOUR SHOES = oyoq kiyimning uchlari
     'a toe' — oyoq barmog'i; kiyimning uchi.

  an APPOINTMENT = belgilangan uchrashuv
     (shifokor, ish uchrashuvi va h.k.)
     Oddiy do'stona uchrashuv — 'a meeting'
     yoki 'a date'.

  a JOKE = hazil, latifa
     'TELL a joke' ('say a joke' XATO).

  MOUTH FULL = og'zi to'la
     'talk with your mouth full' — og'zi to'la
     turib gapirmoq.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

   2  'gift'         → Yaponiya matnida
                       'it is polite to take a
                        gift'
   3  'shoes off'    → Yaponiya matnida
                       'take your shoes off'
   4  'kiss'         → Xitoy matnida
   5  'please/thank you' → Angliya matnida
   6  'blow your nose' → Yaponiya matnida
   7  'chopsticks'   → Xitoy matnida
   8  'queue'        → Angliya matnida
   9  'toes ... towards the door' → Yaponiya
  11  'jokes'        → Xitoy matnida
  12  'mouth full'   → Angliya matnida


DIQQAT — 2-BAND VA XITOY MATNI:
  Xitoy matnida ham sovg'a haqida bor:
  'when you give someone a PRESENT, give it
   with both hands.'

  LEKIN 2-band 'TAKE a gift WITH YOU' deydi —
  ya'ni sovg'ani OLIB BORISH haqida.
  Bu — Yaponiya matnining birinchi gapi:
  'it is polite to TAKE a gift'.

  Xitoy matni esa sovg'ani QANDAY berish
  haqida (ikki qo'llab), olib borish haqida
  emas.


MATNLARDA BOR, LEKIN 12 BANDGA KIRMAGAN
QOIDALAR:
  • XITOY: give a present with both hands
  • YAPONIYA: don't sit anywhere you like —
    wait until someone shows you where to sit
  Bular 8-mashqda ishlatilishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Giving Advice
exercises.instructionUz: Maslahat berish
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — MASLAHAT BERISH

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
    You SHOULD use public transport.
    (= It's a good idea.)

 2 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
    You SHOULDN'T use aerosols.
    (= It isn't a good idea.)

 3 'We can also give advice with:'
    • Why don't you ...?
    • I think it's a good idea to ...
    • I don't think it's a good idea to ...

    Why don't you use public transport?
    I think it's a good idea to use public
      transport.
    I don't think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.


SHOULD — ENG MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1  SHOULD dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli:
        You should USE ...        ✓
        You should to use ...     ✗
        You should USES ...       ✗
        You should USING ...      ✗

  2  Barcha shaxslarda BIR XIL — -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
        I should      we should
        you should    you should
        he should     they should
        she should
        it should

        'He shouldS' — XATO!

  3  Inkor: SHOULD NOT = SHOULDN'T
        You shouldn't use aerosols.
        ('You don't should' — XATO!)

  4  Savol: SHOULD + ega + fe'l
        Should I use public transport?
        ('Do I should ...?' — XATO!)


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD           — oddiy, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
     'You should drink more water.'

  WHY DON'T YOU ?  — do'stona TAKLIF
     'Why don't you drink more water?'
     DIQQAT: shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO — yumshoq FIKR
     'I think it's a good idea to drink more
      water.'


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU ...?':
  Bu — savol EMAS, MASLAHAT.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Nega ... qilmaysiz?'
  Ma'nosi: '... qilib ko'rsangiz-chi?'

  Tuzilishi:
     Why don't you + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... ?
     Why don't you USE public transport?
     ('Why don't you TO use' — XATO)


DIQQAT — 'IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'It's a good idea TO USE public transport.' ✓
  'It's a good idea USING ...'                ✗
  'It's a good idea USE ...'                  ✗

  INKORI — 'don't' BOSH gapga qo'yiladi:
     'I DON'T think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.'                              ✓
     'I think it ISN'T a good idea ...'
      — grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
        inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi.

  Bu — 'inkorni oldinga surish' hodisasi:
     I think he isn't right.  (kam ishlatiladi)
     I DON'T think he is right. (tabiiy)


MASLAHAT BERISHNING BARCHA ShAKLLARI
(ijobiy va salbiy juftlik):

  IJOBIY                     SALBIY
  ────────────────────────   ─────────────────────
  You SHOULD ...             You SHOULDN'T ...
  Why don't you ... ?        (juftligi yo'q)
  I think it's a good        I DON'T think it's a
    idea to ...                good idea to ...


BOG'LIQLIK — BUYRUQ BILAN FARQI:
  BUYRUQ:     'Use public transport.'
              — qat'iy, buyruq ohangi
  MASLAHAT:   'You should use public transport.'
              — yumshoq, tavsiya

  Varaqa (leaflet) BUYRUQ ishlatadi — chunki
  rasmiy e'lon.
  Do'stingizga esa MASLAHAT ishlatasiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice        = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'an advice' XATO
                  'a piece of advice' ✓
  to advise     = maslahat bermoq
  a good idea   = yaxshi fikr
  the right thing = to'g'ri ish

exercises.instructionUz: Stiv sog'lom va tetik bo'lishni xohlaydi. Jadvalga qarang, so'ngra do'sti unga nima deyayotganini tinglang. U qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlarga ✓, qilmasligi kerak bo'lganlariga ✗ qo'ying. So'ngra ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan Stivga maslahat bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQSAD: 'keep fit and healthy'
(tetik va sog'lom bo'lish)

Demak har band SOG'LIQ nuqtai nazaridan
baholanadi — audio kerak emas.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  eat too many hamburgers or pizzas   ✗
  2  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream ✗
  3  eat a lot of fruit and vegetables   ✓
  4  drink fizzy drinks or beer          ✗
  5  drink a lot of water                ✓
  6  have cereal with milk for breakfast ✓
  7  take regular exercise               ✓
  8  walk to work                        ✓

  Ya'ni: ✗ ✗ ✓ ✗ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓
  (3 ta salbiy, 5 ta ijobiy)


KITOBNING O'Z NAMUNASI 1-BANDNI TASDIQLAYDI:
  'I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat too
   many hamburgers or pizzas. OR
   YOU SHOULDN'T eat too many hamburgers or
   pizzas.'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  ✗  Gamburger va pitsada ko'p yog' va tuz
        bor. 'TOO MANY' — haddan tashqari ko'p.
  2  ✗  Shokolad va muzqaymoqda ko'p shakar.
  3  ✓  Meva-sabzavot — vitamin manbai.
        98-betdagi 1-mashqning c-bandi ham shu:
        'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'
  4  ✗  Gazli ichimliklarda ko'p shakar;
        pivo — alkogol.
  5  ✓  Suv organizm uchun zarur.
  6  ✓  Sutli yormali nonushta — to'yimli va
        foydali boshlanish.
  7  ✓  Muntazam jismoniy mashq — sog'liqning
        asosi.
  8  ✓  Piyoda yurish — ham mashq, ham havoni
        ifloslantirmaydi.


HAR BAND UChUN TO'LIQ MASLAHAT
(ikki xil shaklda):

 1  You SHOULDN'T eat too many hamburgers or
    pizzas.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat too
    many hamburgers or pizzas.

 2  You SHOULDN'T eat a lot of chocolate or
    ice-cream.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat a lot
    of chocolate or ice-cream.

 3  You SHOULD eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.
    WHY DON'T YOU eat a lot of fruit and
    vegetables?

 4  You SHOULDN'T drink fizzy drinks or beer.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO drink
    fizzy drinks or beer.

 5  You SHOULD drink a lot of water.
    WHY DON'T YOU drink a lot of water?

 6  You SHOULD have cereal with milk for
    breakfast.
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO have cereal with
    milk for breakfast.

 7  You SHOULD take regular exercise.
    WHY DON'T YOU take regular exercise?

 8  You SHOULD walk to work.
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO walk to work.


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU' FAQAT IJOBIYDA:
  'Why don't you eat fruit?'          ✓
  'Why don't you NOT eat chocolate?'  ✗

  Salbiy maslahat uchun faqat:
     'You shouldn't ...' yoki
     'I don't think it's a good idea to ...'


DIQQAT — 'TOO MANY' va 'A LOT OF':
  1-bandda 'TOO many hamburgers'
     'too many' = HADDAN TASHQARI ko'p (salbiy)
  2-bandda 'A LOT OF chocolate'
     'a lot of' = ko'p (neytral)

  Ya'ni gamburgerni BIROZ yeyish mumkin,
  lekin 'too many' — chegaradan oshgan.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE EXERCISE':
  'TAKE regular exercise' — turg'un ibora.
  'DO exercise' ham to'g'ri.
  'MAKE exercise' — XATO.

  'exercise' bu ma'noda SANALMAYDIGAN:
     'take exercise'  ✓
     'an exercise' — mashq (kitobdagi vazifa)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE CEREAL':
  'to HAVE breakfast/lunch/dinner' = yemoq
  'cereal' — SANALMAYDIGAN (yormali nonushta)
  'a cereal' XATO.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to keep fit    = tetik bo'lib turmoq
  healthy        = sog'lom
  fizzy drinks   = gazli ichimliklar
  cereal         = yormali nonushta
  regular        = muntazam
  exercise       = jismoniy mashq
  to tick        = ✓ belgisini qo'ymoq
  a cross        = ✗ belgisi
  an expression  = ibora

exercises.instructionEn: can/can't, must/mustn't
exercises.instructionUz: can/can't, must/mustn't
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — TO'RT MODAL

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use CAN to give permission.'
      You CAN listen to the radio.
      (= You are ALLOWED to.)
      → RUXSAT BERISH

 2 'We use CAN'T to refuse permission.'
      You CAN'T keep pets in your room.
      (= You AREN'T allowed to.)
      → RUXSAT BERMASLIK

 3 'We use MUST to tell someone to do
    something.' (expressing OBLIGATION)
      You MUST clean your room.
      (= You are OBLIGED to.)
      → MAJBURIYAT

 4 'We use MUSTN'T to tell someone not to do
    something.' (expressing PROHIBITION)
      You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.
      (= It's FORBIDDEN.)
      → TAQIQ


TO'RTTASINI BIR JADVALDA:

            RUXSAT        MAJBURIYAT
  IJOBIY    CAN           MUST
            (mumkin)      (shart)

  SALBIY    CAN'T         MUSTN'T
            (mumkin emas) (mutlaqo mumkin emas)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T':

  CAN'T   — ruxsat berilmagan
            'You can't keep pets.'
            (Uy egasi ruxsat bermayapti.)

  MUSTN'T — TAQIQLANGAN, qonun/qoida
            'You mustn't smoke in hospitals.'
            (Bu — qat'iy taqiq.)

  Amalda ikkalasi ko'pincha almashib
  ishlatiladi, lekin 'mustn't' KUChLIROQ.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':

  MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
     'You mustn't be late.'
     (Kechikish TAQIQLANGAN.)

  DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                  (lekin xohlasangiz mumkin)
     'You don't have to be early.'
     (Erta kelish shart emas.)

  Bu — o'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun eng
  ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!


BARCHASIDAN KEYIN — ASOSIY ShAKL:
  You can LISTEN ...      ✓
  You can TO listen ...   ✗
  You must CLEAN ...      ✓
  You must TO clean ...   ✗
  He must CLEANS ...      ✗ (-S YO'Q!)


HECH QANDAY ShAXSDA -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
  I can / you can / he can / she can /
  it can / we can / they can
  I must / you must / he must / ...

  'He cans' ✗   'She musts' ✗


SAVOL ShAKLI — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  Can I use the telephone?   ✓
  Do I can use ...?          ✗
  Must I make the bed?       ✓
  Do I must ...?             ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can I play music?
     — Yes, you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
  Must I make the bed?
     — Yes, you MUST. / No, you NEEDN'T.
     (DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
      'mustn't' = taqiq, 'needn't' = shart emas.)


'MUST' va 'HAVE TO' — 12-MAShQDAN:
  12-mashqning namunasi:
     SA: 'Do I HAVE TO make the bed?'
     SB: 'Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.'

  Ya'ni SAVOLDA 'have to', JAVOBDA 'must'.
  Nega? Chunki 'must' savol shaklida kamroq
  ishlatiladi — 'Do I have to ...?' tabiiyroq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  permission   = ruxsat
  to allow     = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed      = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse    = rad etmoq
  obligation   = majburiyat
  obliged      = majbur
  prohibition  = taqiq
  forbidden    = taqiqlangan

tasks.en: can/can't, must/mustn't
tasks.uz: can/can't, must/mustn't

tasks.en: We use can to give permission. You can listen to the radio. (You are allowed to.)
tasks.uz: RUXSAT BERISH uchun CAN ishlatamiz. Radio eshitishingiz mumkin. (Sizga ruxsat etilgan.)

tasks.en: We use can't to refuse permission. You can't keep pets in your room. (You aren't allowed to.)
tasks.uz: RUXSAT BERMASLIK uchun CAN'T ishlatamiz. Xonangizda uy hayvonlarini saqlay olmaysiz. (Sizga ruxsat etilmagan.)
tasks.note:
11-mashqda kitob 'keep pets' ni CAN'T ustuniga
belgilagan — aynan shu misoldan.

tasks.en: We use must to tell someone to do something. (expressing obligation) You must clean your room. (You are obliged to.)
tasks.uz: Kimgadir biror ishni qilishni aytish uchun MUST ishlatamiz (MAJBURIYAT). Xonangizni tozalashingiz shart. (Siz majbursiz.)
tasks.note:
Bu misol 11-mashqning 'keep the room clean'
qatorini tasdiqlaydi → MUST.

tasks.en: We use mustn't to tell someone not to do something. (expressing prohibition) You mustn't smoke in hospitals. (It's forbidden.)
tasks.uz: Kimgadir biror ishni qilmaslikni aytish uchun MUSTN'T ishlatamiz (TAQIQ). Kasalxonalarda chekish mumkin emas. (Bu taqiqlangan.)
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: 'mustn't' (taqiq) va 'don't have to'
(shart emas) — BUTUNLAY boshqa ma'no!

BETNING O'ZI 5 QATORNI TASDIQLAYDI:

  You CAN use the telephone.

  You MUST keep the room clean.


DIQQAT — JADVAL OSTIDAGI NAMUNA:

YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  loud          = baland (ovoz)

tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✓ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Uch marta tasdiqlanadi:
  1) jadvalda ✓ CAN'T ustunida
  2) grammatika qutisi:
     'You CAN'T keep pets in your room.'
  3) jadval ostidagi namuna gap:
     'You can't keep pets.'

TO'LIQ GAP: You can't keep pets.

12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Can I play loud music?'
  SB: 'NO, YOU CAN'T.'

Mantiq ham shuni ko'rsatadi: baland musiqa
boshqa ijarachilarga xalaqit beradi.

TO'LIQ GAP: You can't play loud music.

12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Can I use the telephone?'
  SB: 'YES, OF COURSE YOU CAN.'

'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi
(ya'ni bu oddiy, muammosiz narsa).

TO'LIQ GAP: You can use the telephone.

12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Do I have to make the bed?'
  SB: 'Yes, you do. YOU MUST MAKE THE BED.'

DIQQAT: savolda 'have to', javobda 'must' —
ma'nosi bir xil, lekin savolda 'Do I have to'
tabiiyroq.

TO'LIQ GAP: You must make the bed.

GRAMMATIKA QUTISINING MISOLI TASDIQLAYDI:
  'You MUST CLEAN YOUR ROOM.'
  (= majburiyat, obligation)

Kitob 'must' ni tushuntirish uchun aynan shu
misolni tanlagan — bu tasodif emas.

'to KEEP + ot + SIFAT' = ... holatda saqlamoq:
  keep the room clean
  keep the door open

TO'LIQ GAP: You must keep the room clean.

GRAMMAR BOOK 60-BET TASDIQLAYDI:
'must' ning ishlatilishi tushuntirilgan joyda
kitob aynan shu misolni bergan:
  'b) for RULES —
      You MUST BE HOME BY 11 PM.'

Ya'ni uy egasining qoidasi → MUST.

DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  'be home BY 11 pm' = 11 GACHA yetib kelish
  'stay home UNTIL 11 pm' = 11 gacha uyda TURISH

TO'LIQ GAP: You must be home by 11 pm.

KO'RSATMALAR RO'YXATI (10 ta):

RASMDA 9 TA RAQAMLANGAN O'QUVCHI:

  1  Yashil koftali qiz, og'zidan PUFAK
     chiqib turibdi          → saqich chaynayapti
  2  Sariq sochli bola devorga 'I ♥ KATE' deb
     YOZYAPTI                → devorga yozyapti
  3  Sariq sochli qiz (to'q sariq kofta,
     ayiqcha rasmi), qo'lida qalam, boshini
     yon tomonga burib qarayapti
                             → nusxa ko'chiryapti
  4  Sariq sochli bola boshini partaga qo'yib
     UXLAYAPTI               → uxlayapti
  5  Binafsha koftali bola qo'lida non/pishiriq,
     og'zi ochiq             → OVQAT YEYAPTI
  6  Yashil va jigarrang koftali ikki bola
     bo'yinlashib OLIShYAPTI → urishyapti
  7  Sariq koftali bola tirjayib, g'ijimlangan
     qog'ozlarni OTYAPTI     → sinfni ifloslantiryapti
  8  Qizil koftali qiz partadagi qutidagi
     MUShUKChAGA qo'l cho'zgan
                             → maktabga hayvon olib kelgan
  9  Ikki qiz boshlarini qo'shib PIChIRLAShYAPTI
                             → gaplashyaptilar


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  You MUSTN'T chew gum in class.
  2  You MUSTN'T write on the walls.
  3  You MUSTN'T cheat in tests.
  4  You MUSTN'T sleep in class.
  5  You MUSTN'T eat in class.
  6  You MUSTN'T fight in class.
  7  You MUST keep the classroom clean.
  8  You MUSTN'T bring pets into school.
  9  You MUSTN'T talk to each other in class.

  (be quiet in class → You MUST be quiet in
   class. — alohida o'quvchisi yo'q)


⚠ KITOBNING O'Z XATOSI:

  Kitob namuna sifatida yozgan:
     '1-You mustn't EAT in class.'

  LEKIN rasmda 1-o'quvchi SAQICH CHAYNAYAPTI —
  og'zidan pufak chiqib turibdi.
  OVQAT yeyayotgani esa 5-o'quvchi (binafsha
  koftali bola, qo'lida pishiriq).

  Rasm 5 barobar kattalashtirilib tekshirildi.

  Ehtimol kitob '1-' deganda RO'YXATNING
  birinchi so'zini ('eat in class') nazarda
  tutgan, RASMDAGI 1-o'quvchini emas.

  Ikkala variant ham quyida ko'rsatildi.


DIQQAT — IKKI TA IJOBIY KO'RSATMA:

  Ro'yxatdagi 10 tadan 8 tasi SALBIY
  (mustn't), lekin IKKITASI IJOBIY (must):

     keep the classroom clean
        → You MUST keep the classroom clean.
     be quiet in class
        → You MUST be quiet in class.

  Mashq nomi ham shuni aytadi:
  'what they MUST OR MUSTN'T do'.

  Agar ularni ham 'mustn't' bilan yozsangiz,
  ma'no TESKARI bo'lib qoladi:
     'You mustn't keep the classroom clean' ✗
     (= sinfni toza tutish taqiqlangan!)


DIQQAT — 9 O'QUVCHI, 10 KO'RSATMA:
  'be quiet in class' ga alohida o'quvchi
  to'g'ri kelmaydi — bu butun sinfga tegishli
  umumiy qoida.
  (6-urishuv va 9-gaplashuv ham shovqin
   qiladi, lekin ular boshqa ko'rsatmalarni
   olgan.)
  Taxmin bilan bog'lanmadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  to cheat      = aldamoq, nusxa ko'chirmoq
  a test        = nazorat ishi

  quiet         = jim, tinch
  a classroom   = sinfxona
  to bring into = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  each other    = bir-biri

exercises.instructionEn: Giving Advice
exercises.instructionUz: Maslahat berish
exercises.explanationUz:
SHOULD / SHOULDN'T — NAZARIYA

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
      You SHOULD take regular exercise.
      (= It's a good idea.)

 • 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
      You SHOULDN'T drop rubbish in the street.
      (= It isn't a good idea.)

 • 'We can also give advice with:
    WHY DON'T YOU ...?
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...,
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...'

      Why don't you take regular exercise?
      I think it's a good idea to take regular
        exercise.
      I don't think it's a good idea to eat
        junk food.


TO'LIQ TUSLANISh:

  TASDIQ:
     I should go        we should go
     you should go      you should go
     he should go       they should go
     she should go
     it should go

  INKOR:
     I should not go = I shouldn't go
     (barcha shaxslarda bir xil)

  SO'ROQ:
     Should I go?
     Should he go?
     ...


UCh OLTIN QOIDA:

 1  -S HECH QAChON QO'ShILMAYDI:
       'He should go.'    ✓
       'He shouldS go.'   ✗

 2  'TO' YO'Q:
       'You should take ...'    ✓
       'You should TO take ...' ✗

 3  'DO' KERAK EMAS:
       'Should I go?'      ✓
       'DO I should go?'   ✗
       'I shouldn't go.'   ✓
       'I DON'T should go.' ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Should I take an aspirin?
     — Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD
     'You should take regular exercise.'
     → to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, oddiy

  WHY DON'T YOU ...?
     'Why don't you take regular exercise?'
     → shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT
     → do'stona taklif

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I think it's a good idea to take regular
      exercise.'
     → yumshoq shaxsiy fikr

  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I don't think it's a good idea to eat
      junk food.'
     → yumshoq salbiy fikr


DIQQAT — INKOR QAYERGA QO'YILADI:
  'I DON'T think it's a good idea to ...' ✓
     (inkor BOSH gapda)
  'I think it ISN'T a good idea to ...'
     (grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
      inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi)


DIQQAT — 'A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'a good idea TO TAKE exercise'   ✓
  'a good idea TAKING exercise'    ✗
  'a good idea TAKE exercise'      ✗


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU + ASOSIY fe'l':
  'Why don't you TAKE exercise?'    ✓
  'Why don't you TO take exercise?' ✗
  'Why don't you TAKING exercise?'  ✗


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  regular exercise = muntazam jismoniy mashq
  to drop rubbish  = axlat tashlamoq
  junk food        = zararli tez ovqat
                     (gamburger, chips va h.k.)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK BILAN:
  Bu qoida Coursebook 99-betdagi
  'Giving Advice' qutisi bilan AYNAN bir xil,
  faqat misollari boshqa.

exercises.instructionUz: Must / Mustn't — tasdiq, so'roq, inkor
exercises.explanationUz:
MUST — TO'LIQ TUSLANISh

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I must stay          we must stay
     you must stay        you must stay
     he must stay         they must stay
     she must stay
     it must stay

SO'ROQ (Interrogative):
     Must I stay?         Must we stay?
     Must you stay?       Must you stay?
     Must he stay?        Must they stay?
     Must she stay?
     Must it stay?

INKOR (Negative):
     TO'LIQ ShAKL         QISQA ShAKL
     I must not stay      I mustn't stay
     you must not stay    you mustn't stay
     he must not stay     he mustn't stay
     she must not stay    she mustn't stay
     it must not stay     it mustn't stay
     we must not stay     we mustn't stay
     you must not stay    you mustn't stay
     they must not stay   they mustn't stay


ENG MUHIM XUSUSIYAT:
  'MUST' BARCHA ShAXSLARDA BIR XIL —
  hech qanday o'zgarish yo'q!

     'He must stay.'   ✓
     'He mustS stay.'  ✗
     'He must stayS.'  ✗


SO'ROQ — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
     'Must I stay?'     ✓
     'Do I must stay?'  ✗

  MUST ni EGADAN OLDINGA qo'yish yetarli.


INKOR — 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS:
     'I must not stay.' ✓
     'I don't must stay.' ✗

  'NOT' ni MUST dan KEYIN qo'yish yetarli.


'MUSTN'T' TALAFFUZI:
  /ˈmʌsnt/ — 'masnt'
  DIQQAT: birinchi 'T' O'QILMAYDI!
  ('must not' da esa o'qiladi.)


MUST NIMA UChUN IShLATILADI — UCh HOLAT:

 KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  a)  TO EXPRESS OBLIGATION (majburiyat)
         'You MUST KEEP the room clean.'

  b)  FOR RULES (qoidalar uchun)
         'You MUST BE home by 11 pm.'

  c)  TO GIVE ADVICE (maslahat berish)
         'You MUST SEE a dentist.'
         (I STRONGLY advise you.)


DIQQAT — c) HOLATI ENG NOZIK:
  'MUST' maslahat uchun ham ishlatiladi,
  lekin 'should' dan ANChA KUCHLIROQ:

     'You SHOULD see a dentist.'
        → oddiy maslahat
     'You MUST see a dentist.'
        → QAT'IY maslahat
          ('I strongly advise you')

  Kitob buni qavs ichida aytadi:
  '(I STRONGLY advise you.)'


MUSTN'T NIMANI ANGLATADI:

 KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'MUSTN'T means "IT IS FORBIDDEN" or
   "IT ISN'T RIGHT".'

     'You MUSTN'T PARK here.'
     (= It is FORBIDDEN to park here,
        it is AGAINST THE RULE.)


DIQQAT — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':
  Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!

     MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
                     (TAQIQ)
        'You mustn't park here.'
        (Bu yerga qo'yish TAQIQLANGAN.)

     DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                     (lekin mumkin)
        'You don't have to park here.'
        (Bu yerga qo'yish shart emas —
         boshqa joyga ham qo'yishingiz mumkin.)

  O'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi — shuning uchun
  adashish oson.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Must I stay?
     — Yes, you must.
     — No, you NEEDN'T. (shart emas)

  DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
     'No, you needn't.'  = qolish shart emas
     'No, you mustn't.'  = qolish TAQIQLANGAN


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay          = qolmoq
  obligation       = majburiyat
  a rule           = qoida
  forbidden        = taqiqlangan
  against the rule = qoidaga zid
  strongly         = qat'iy, kuchli
  to advise        = maslahat bermoq


⚠ MUHIM BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK 101-BET:
  Bu betdagi ikki misol Coursebook 101-betning
  11-mashqidagi jadval qatorlarini TASDIQLAYDI:

     'You must KEEP THE ROOM CLEAN.'
        → 'keep the room clean' = MUST ✓

     'You must BE HOME BY 11 PM.'
        → 'be home by 11 pm' = MUST ✓

  Ikkinchisi 101-betda audio uchun ochiq
  qolgan edi — endi kitobning O'ZIDAN
  tasdiqlandi.

exercises.instructionEn: Can/Can't - Could/Couldn't — Form and Use
exercises.instructionUz: Can/Can't - Could/Couldn't — yasalishi va ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
COULD — TO'LIQ TUSLANISh

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I could swim         we could swim
     you could swim       you could swim
     he could swim        they could swim
     she could swim
     it could swim

SO'ROQ (Interrogative):
     Could I swim?        Could we swim?
     Could you swim?      Could you swim?
     Could he swim?       Could they swim?
     Could she swim?
     Could it swim?

INKOR (Negative):
     TO'LIQ ShAKL         QISQA ShAKL
     I could not swim     I couldn't swim
     you could not swim   you couldn't swim
     he could not swim    he couldn't swim
     she could not swim   she couldn't swim
     it could not swim    it couldn't swim
     we could not swim    we couldn't swim
     you could not swim   you couldn't swim
     they could not swim  they couldn't swim


YASALIShI (FORM) — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting CAN or
    COULD BEFORE THE SUBJECT.'
       CAN THEY swim?  /  COULD THEY swim?

 • 'We form the NEGATIVE by putting the word NOT
    AFTER can or could.'
       They CANNOT / CAN'T swim well.
       They COULD NOT / COULDN'T swim well.


DIQQAT — 'CANNOT' BIR SO'Z:
  'CANNOT'   ✓  (qo'shib yoziladi!)
  'can not'  — kam ishlatiladi
  'CAN'T'    ✓  (qisqa shakl)

  Bu — inglizchadagi yagona modal fe'l
  bo'lib, inkori QO'ShIB yoziladi:
     could not  → couldn't (ayrim)
     must not   → mustn't  (ayrim)
     cannot                 (QO'ShIQ!)


IShLATILIShI (USE) — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use CAN to show that someone has the
    ABILITY to do something IN THE PRESENT.
    We use COULD to show that someone HAD the
    ability to do something IN THE PAST.'

       HOZIR:  I CAN swim.
               (Men suza olaman.)
       O'TGAN:  I COULD swim when I was five.
               (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)

 • 'We also use CAN to give PERMISSION.'
       You CAN watch TV.
       (You are allowed to.)

 • 'We use CAN'T to REFUSE permission.'
       You CAN'T watch TV.
       (You aren't allowed to.)


CAN NING IKKI MA'NOSI:

  1  QOBILIYAT (ability)
        'I can swim.' = suza olaman
        'I can speak English.'

  2  RUXSAT (permission)
        'You can watch TV.' = ruxsat berilgan
        'Can I use your phone?'

  Qaysi ma'no ekanini KONTEKST ko'rsatadi.


COULD — 'CAN' NING O'TGAN ZAMONI:

     HOZIR              O'TGAN
     I can swim.        I could swim.
     I can't swim.      I couldn't swim.
     Can you swim?      Could you swim?

  Misol:
     'I COULD run very fast when I was young,
      but now I CAN'T.'
     (Yosh vaqtimda juda tez yugurardim,
      lekin hozir yugura olmayman.)


DIQQAT — 'COULD' NING IKKINChI VAZIFASI:
  'Could' o'tgan zamondan tashqari,
  ODOBLI ILTIMOS uchun ham ishlatiladi:

     'CAN you help me?'    — oddiy
     'COULD you help me?'  — ODOBLIROQ

  Bu holatda o'tgan zamon ma'nosi YO'Q.


BARCHA MODALLARGA UMUMIY UCh QOIDA:

 1  -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
       he can, he could, he must, he should
       ('he cans' ✗)

 2  'TO' YO'Q:
       'I can swim.'    ✓
       'I can TO swim.' ✗

 3  'DO' KERAK EMAS:
       'Can you swim?'     ✓
       'Do you can swim?'  ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can you swim?
     — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
  Could you swim when you were five?
     — Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ability       = qobiliyat
  able          = qodir
  the present   = hozirgi zamon
  the past      = o'tgan zamon
  to allow      = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed       = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse     = rad etmoq
  the subject   = ega (grammatikada)
  affirmative   = tasdiq
  interrogative = so'roq
  negative      = inkor

tasks.en: We form the interrogative by putting can or could before the subject. Can they swim? / Could they swim?
tasks.uz: So'roq shaklini can yoki could ni egadan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. Ular suza oladimi? / Ular suza olarmidi?

tasks.en: We use can to show that someone has the ability to do something in the present. We use could to show that someone had the ability to do something in the past.

CAN = hozir; COULD = o'tmishda.
'I could swim when I was five.'

CAN ning IKKINCHI ma'nosi: RUXSAT.
Coursebook 101-bet bilan bir xil.

tasks.en: We use can't to refuse permission. You can't watch TV. (You aren't allowed to.)
tasks.uz: CAN'T ni ruxsat bermaslik uchun ishlatamiz. Televizor ko'ra olmaysiz. (Sizga ruxsat etilmagan.)

JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)
  /r/ SILENT      (jim)

TO'RT SO'Z: turn, care, hurry, various


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

QOIDA — BRITANCHA INGLIZChADA:

  /r/ FAQAT UNLIDAN OLDIN o'qiladi.

  Agar 'r' dan keyin:
     UNLI kelsa       →  O'QILADI
     UNDOSh kelsa     →  JIM

HAR BIRI NEGA:

  TURN   →  t-u-R-N
            'r' dan keyin 'n' (UNDOSh)
            →  JIM

  CARE   →  c-a-R-e
            'r' SO'Z OXIRIDA ('e' jim)
            →  JIM
            O'qilishi: /keə/ — 'keэ'

  HURRY  →  h-u-RR-Y
            'r' dan keyin 'y' (UNLI tovush /i/)
            →  O'QILADI
            O'qilishi: /ˈhʌri/ — 'hari'

  VARIOUS → v-a-R-I-ous
            'r' dan keyin 'i' (UNLI)
            →  O'QILADI
            O'qilishi: /ˈveəriəs/ — 'veэriэs'

            DIQQAT: bu so'zda IKKI 'r' emas,
            bitta 'r' bor va u unlidan oldin.


DEMAK AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Qoida to'rtala so'zni ham ANIQ belgilaydi.


DIQQAT — BRITANCHA va AMERIKACHA FARQI:

  Bu qoida FAQAT britancha inglizchada
  ishlaydi. Amerikachada 'r' DOIM o'qiladi:

     SO'Z     BRITANCHA    AMERIKACHA
     turn     /tɜːn/       /tɜːrn/
     care     /keə/        /ker/
     car      /kɑː/        /kɑːr/
     teacher  /ˈtiːtʃə/    /ˈtiːtʃər/

  Enterprise — BRITANCHA kitob, shuning uchun
  britancha qoida ishlatiladi.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR (qoidani mustahkamlash
uchun):

  /r/ JIM (undoshdan oldin yoki so'z oxirida):
     car, far, star, door, four, more
     park, work, first, girl, world
     teacher, mother, father, water
     hard, card, part, short

  /r/ O'QILADI (unlidan oldin):
     red, run, read, rain, room
     very, sorry, marry, carry, borrow
     around, arrive, correct, agree
     Africa, America, orange


QIZIQ HODISA — 'LINKING R':
  So'z oxiridagi jim 'r' KEYINGI so'z unli
  bilan boshlansa, QAYTA JONLANADI:

     'car' — /kɑː/          (r jim)
     'a car is here' — /kɑːr ɪz/  (r o'qiladi!)

     'far' — /fɑː/
     'far away' — /fɑːr əweɪ/  (r o'qiladi!)

  Chunki keyingi so'z UNLI bilan boshlanadi —
  qoida buzilmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to turn      = burilmoq, aylantirmoq
  to care      = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq
  care         = g'amxo'rlik

exercises.instructionEn: What advice can you give to visitors to England, China and Japan? Give at least three pieces of advice for each country.
exercises.instructionUz: Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaga boruvchilarga qanday maslahat bera olasiz? Har bir mamlakat uchun kamida uchta maslahat bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'When in England, you SHOULD say "please" and
   "thank you".'

  QOLIP:
     When in [mamlakat], you should / shouldn't
     + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...


ANGLIYA — BESH MASLAHAT:

  1  When in England, you SHOULD always say
     'please' and 'thank you'.
  2  You SHOULDN'T push into a queue of people,
     because they'll get angry.
  3  You SHOULDN'T be late for appointments.
  4  You SHOULDN'T talk with your mouth full.
  5  You SHOULD always ask before smoking in
     someone's house.


XITOY — BESH MASLAHAT:

  1  When in China, you SHOULDN'T kiss anyone in
     public, because it's very rude.
  2  You SHOULDN'T be late for appointments.
  3  You SHOULDN'T tell jokes to people you
     don't know very well.
  4  You SHOULDN'T leave your chopsticks
     pointing upwards in your rice.
  5  You SHOULD give a present with both hands.


YAPONIYA — BESH MASLAHAT:

  1  When in Japan, you SHOULD take a gift when
     you visit someone.
  2  You SHOULD take your shoes off as you enter
     the house.
  3  You SHOULD make sure the toes of your shoes
     are pointing towards the door.
  4  You SHOULDN'T sit anywhere you like — you
     should wait until someone shows you where
     to sit.
  5  You SHOULDN'T blow your nose in public.


BOShQA ShAKLLAR BILAN (99-betdan):

  WHY DON'T YOU ...?
     'Why don't you take a gift with you?'

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I think it's a good idea to say "please"
      and "thank you".'

  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I don't think it's a good idea to kiss
      anyone in public in China.'

  BUYRUQ (matnlardagidek):
     'Always say "please" and "thank you".'
     'Never push into a queue.'


DIQQAT — 'ADVICE' SANALMAYDIGAN:
  Kitob ataylab 'three PIECES OF advice'
  deydi, 'three advices' emas!

     'an advice'      ✗
     'three advices'  ✗
     'a piece of advice'     ✓
     'three pieces of advice' ✓
     'some advice'    ✓

  Xuddi shunday sanalmaydigan otlar:
     information — a piece of information
     news        — a piece of news
     furniture   — a piece of furniture
     bread       — a piece of bread


DIQQAT — 'WHEN IN ENGLAND':
  Bu — qisqartma:
     'when (you are) in England'

  Ergash gapda ega 'you' va 'to be' fe'li
  tushirib qoldirilgan. Rasmiy va ixcham
  shakl.

  Xitoy matni ham shunday boshlanadi:
  'WHEN IN CHINA, don't kiss anyone ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice          = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a piece of advice = bitta maslahat
  a visitor       = mehmon, tashrif buyuruvchi
  at least        = kamida

tasks.en: What advice can you give to visitors to England, China and Japan? Give at least three pieces of advice for each country.
tasks.uz: Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaga boruvchilarga qanday maslahat bera olasiz? Har bir mamlakat uchun kamida uchta maslahat bering.

tasks.en: When in England, you should say 'please' and 'thank you'.
tasks.uz: Angliyada 'iltimos' va 'rahmat' deyishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'when in England' = 'when you are in England'.

tasks.en: When in England, you shouldn't push into a queue of people, because they'll get angry.
tasks.uz: Angliyada odamlar navbatiga suqilib kirmasligingiz kerak, chunki ularning jahli chiqadi.

tasks.en: When in England, you shouldn't be late for appointments or talk with your mouth full.
tasks.uz: Angliyada uchrashuvlarga kechikmasligingiz va og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmasligingiz kerak.

tasks.en: When in England, you should always ask before smoking in someone's house.
tasks.uz: Angliyada birovning uyida chekishdan oldin doim ruxsat so'rashingiz kerak.

tasks.en: When in China, you shouldn't kiss anyone in public, because it's very rude.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda odamlar oldida hech kimni o'pmasligingiz kerak, chunki bu juda qo'pol.

tasks.en: When in China, you shouldn't tell jokes to people you don't know very well.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda yaxshi tanimaydigan odamlarga hazil aytmasligingiz kerak.

tasks.en: When in China, you shouldn't leave your chopsticks pointing upwards in your rice, and you should give a present with both hands.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda tayoqchalarni guruchga tik qoldirmasligingiz kerak va sovg'ani ikki qo'llab berishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
XITOY — 4 va 5-maslahat birga.
Ikki qo'llab berish matnda bor, lekin 12 bandga
kirmagan.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you should take a gift when you visit someone.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada birovnikiga borganingizda sovg'a olib borishingiz kerak.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you should take your shoes off as you enter the house and make sure the toes are pointing towards the door.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada uyga kirayotganda oyoq kiyimingizni yechishingiz va uchlari eshikka qaraganiga ishonch hosil qilishingiz kerak.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you shouldn't sit anywhere you like — you should wait until someone shows you where to sit.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada xohlagan joyingizga o'tirmasligingiz kerak — kimdir qayerga o'tirishni ko'rsatgunicha kutishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
YAPONIYA — 4-maslahat.
Matnda bor, lekin 12 bandga kirmagan.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you shouldn't blow your nose in public.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada odamlar oldida burningizni qoqmasligingiz kerak.

tasks.en: Give at least three pieces of advice for each country.
tasks.uz: Har bir mamlakat uchun kamida uchta maslahat bering.

DIQQAT: 'three PIECES OF advice'.
'advice' SANALMAYDIGAN — 'three advices' XATO.

exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ishlang. 11-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, namunalardagidek qisqa dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1  SA: Do I HAVE TO make the bed?
     SB: Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.

  2  SA: CAN I play loud music?
     SB: No, you CAN'T.

  3  SA: CAN I use the telephone?
     SB: Yes, of course you CAN.


TARJIMASI:
  1  SA: To'shakni yig'ishtirishim shartmi?
     SB: Ha, shart. To'shakni yig'ishtirishingiz
         kerak.
  2  SA: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi?
     SB: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.
  3  SA: Telefondan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
     SB: Ha, albatta bo'ladi.


IKKI XIL SAVOL — QAY BIRINI QAChON:

  MAJBURIYAT haqida so'raganda:
     'DO I HAVE TO + fe'l?'
     → Javobi: 'Yes, you do. You MUST ...'
              yoki 'No, you don't.'

  RUXSAT so'raganda:
     'CAN I + fe'l?'
     → Javobi: 'Yes, you can.' /
              'Yes, of course you can.' /
              'No, you can't.'


DIQQAT — NEGA 'DO I HAVE TO', 'MUST I' EMAS:
  'Must I make the bed?' — grammatik jihatdan
  to'g'ri, lekin ZAMONAVIY inglizchada kam
  ishlatiladi.
  'Do I have to ...?' — ancha tabiiyroq.

  Lekin JAVOBDA 'must' ishlatiladi:
     'You MUST make the bed.'


DIQQAT — 'CAN I' va 'MAY I':
  'CAN I use the telephone?' — oddiy, og'zaki
  'MAY I use the telephone?' — RASMIY, odobli
  'COULD I use the telephone?' — juda odobli

  Kitob eng oddiy shaklni bergan.


TASDIQLANGAN 5 QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  SA: Can I keep pets?
    SB: No, you can't.

 2  SA: Can I play loud music?
    SB: No, you can't.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Can I use the telephone?
    SB: Yes, of course you can.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 4  SA: Do I have to make the bed?
    SB: Yes, you do. You must make the bed.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 5  SA: Do I have to keep the room clean?
    SB: Yes, you do. You must keep the room
        clean.


QOLGAN 5 QATOR UChUN QOLIP
(audio tinglangandan keyin to'ldiriladi):

    SA: Can I have parties in the room?
    SB: ...

    SA: Can I have a TV in the room?
    SB: ...

    SA: Can I put posters on the walls?
    SB: ...

    SA: Do I have to pay the rent on time?
    SB: ...

    SA: Do I have to be home by 11 pm?
    SB: ...


QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  SAVOL              IJOBIY JAVOB      SALBIY JAVOB
  ─────────────────  ────────────────  ─────────────
  Can I ...?         Yes, you can.     No, you can't.
                     Yes, of course
                     you can.
  Do I have to ...?  Yes, you do.      No, you don't.
                     You must ...


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA FE'L TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  'Can I play music?' — 'Yes, you can.'   ✓
  'Can I play music?' — 'Yes, you can play
                         music.'          (ortiqcha)

  Qisqa javobda faqat MODAL qoladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Do I have to ...?  = ... qilishim shartmi?
  Can I ...?         = ... qilsam bo'ladimi?
  of course          = albatta
  a prompt           = tayanch so'z, ko'rsatma

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1-DIALOG:
     A:  Tony, WHAT'S THE MATTER?
     B:  I've got a terrible headache.
     A:  WHY DON'T YOU take an aspirin?

     Tarjimasi:
     A:  Toni, nima bo'ldi?
     B:  Boshim juda qattiq og'riyapti.
     A:  Aspirin ichsangiz-chi?

  2-DIALOG:
     A:  Bob, WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOU?
     B:  I feel very tired.
     A:  YOU SHOULD get some sleep.

     Tarjimasi:
     A:  Bob, sizga nima bo'ldi?
     B:  Juda charchadim.
     A:  Uxlab olishingiz kerak.


DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A:  [ism], what's the matter? /
      what's wrong with you?
  B:  I've got a/the [kasallik]. /
      I feel very [sifat].
  A:  Why don't you [maslahat]? /
      You should [maslahat].


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SAVOL, BIR XIL MA'NO:
  'What's the matter?'      = Nima bo'ldi?
  'What's wrong with you?'  = Sizga nima bo'ldi?

  Ikkalasi ham kasal odamdan so'raladi.
  Yana: 'What's the matter WITH YOU?'


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI:
  1-dialogda:  'WHY DON'T YOU take ...?'
               (savol shaklida — do'stona)
  2-dialogda:  'YOU SHOULD get ...'
               (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri)

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini ko'rsatgan —
  99-betdagi 'Giving Advice' qutisidan.


OLTITA TO'LIQ DIALOG (9-mashqning barcha
bandlari uchun):

 1  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I've got a terrible headache.
    A:  Why don't you take an aspirin?

 2  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got a sore throat.
    A:  You should take some cough syrup.

 3  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I feel very cold.
    A:  Why don't you put a jumper on?

 4  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got the flu.
    A:  You should call the doctor and go to bed.

 5  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I feel very tired.
    A:  Why don't you get some sleep?

 6  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got toothache.
    A:  You should see the dentist.


DIQQAT — 'TERRIBLE':
  Namunada 'a TERRIBLE headache' deyilgan.
  'terrible' = dahshatli, juda qattiq —
  kasallikni kuchaytirish uchun.

  Yana: awful, bad, splitting (bosh og'rig'i
  uchun: 'a splitting headache').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What's the matter?     = Nima bo'ldi?
  What's wrong with you? = Sizga nima bo'ldi?
  terrible               = dahshatli, juda qattiq
  to act out             = sahnalashtirmoq
  a prompt               = ko'rsatma, tayanch so'z

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues and fill in must, mustn't, can, can't, should or shouldn't, then listen and check your answers. Finally, in pairs, act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va must, mustn't, can, can't, should yoki shouldn't so'zlaridan mosini qo'ying, so'ngra tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring. Oxirida juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH DIALOG — HAR BIRINING SARLAVHASI
JAVOBNI AYTIB TURIBDI!

  a) giving ADVICE        →  should / shouldn't
  b) giving PERMISSION    →  can
  c) expressing OBLIGATION →  must
  d) refusing PERMISSION  →  can / can't
  e) expressing PROHIBITION →  mustn't

  Ya'ni AUDIO ShART EMAS — sarlavhalar
  javobni belgilab beradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  a) 1  SHOULD
     2  SHOULDN'T
  b) 1  CAN   2  CAN
  c)    MUST
  d) 1  CAN   2  CAN'T
  e)    MUSTN'T


HAR BIR DIALOG TO'LIQ:

 a) GIVING ADVICE (maslahat berish)

    A:  I can't see that sign very well.
    B:  You SHOULD see an optician.

    A:  I feel tired.
    B:  You SHOULDN'T go to bed so late.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Anavi belgini yaxshi ko'ra olmayapman.
    B:  Ko'z shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.
    A:  Charchadim.
    B:  Bunchalik kech yotmasligingiz kerak.


 b) GIVING PERMISSION (ruxsat berish)

    A:  CAN I use your phone, please?
    B:  Yes, of course you CAN.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Ha, albatta bo'ladi.


 c) EXPRESSING OBLIGATION (majburiyat)

    A:  Do I have to wash the dishes?
    B:  Yes, you do! You MUST wash the dishes —
        it's your turn!

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Idish yuvishim shartmi?
    B:  Ha, shart! Idish yuvishingiz kerak —
        sizning navbatingiz!


 d) REFUSING PERMISSION (ruxsat bermaslik)

    A:  Mum, CAN I have some sweets?
    B:  No, you CAN'T. They're bad for your
        teeth.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Oyi, shirinlik yesam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Ular tishga zarar.


 e) EXPRESSING PROHIBITION (taqiq)

    A:  Can I park here?
    B:  No, you can't. You MUSTN'T park here —
        it's illegal.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Bu yerga mashina qo'ysam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Bu yerga qo'yish mumkin
        emas — bu qonunga xilof.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — d) va e):

  Ikkalasi ham RAD ETADI, lekin SABABI boshqa:

  d) CAN'T — ONA ruxsat bermayapti
     (shaxsiy qaror, shirinlik zararli)

  e) MUSTN'T — QONUN taqiqlagan
     ('it's ILLEGAL')

  Shuning uchun e) da avval 'you can't'
  deyilib, keyin 'you MUSTN'T' bilan
  KUCHAYTIRILADI.


DIQQAT — a) DAGI IKKI TOMONI:
  'You SHOULD see an optician.'
     → nima QILISh kerak (ijobiy maslahat)
  'You SHOULDN'T go to bed so late.'
     → nima QILMASLIK kerak (salbiy maslahat)

  DIQQAT: 'I feel tired' ga javob 'shouldn't' —
  chunki gap KELAJAKDA kech yotmaslik haqida,
  hozir uxlash haqida emas.


DIQQAT — c) DAGI 'DO I HAVE TO':
  Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must' —
  101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.


DIQQAT — 'AN OPTICIAN':
  optician  = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik
  Ko'z shifokori: an eye doctor / an
  ophthalmologist.
  Kundalik nutqda 'optician' ishlatiladi.


O'XShASh DIALOGLAR TUZISh (mashqning oxirgi
qismi):

  a) maslahat:
     A: I've got a headache.
     B: You should take an aspirin.

  b) ruxsat berish:
     A: Can I open the window?
     B: Yes, of course you can.

  c) majburiyat:
     A: Do I have to make my bed?
     B: Yes, you do! You must make your bed.

  d) ruxsat bermaslik:
     A: Can I watch TV now?
     B: No, you can't. You haven't done your
        homework.

  e) taqiq:
     A: Can I smoke here?
     B: No, you can't. You mustn't smoke in
        hospitals — it's forbidden.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a sign        = belgi, lavha
  an optician   = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik
  to wash the dishes = idish yuvmoq
  your turn     = sizning navbatingiz
  sweets        = shirinliklar
  teeth         = tishlar (tooth ko'pligi)
  to park       = mashina qo'ymoq
  illegal       = qonunga xilof
  legal         = qonuniy

tasks.prompt: a) giving advice —  A: I can't see that sign very well.  B: You ............... see an optician.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving ADVICE' (maslahat).
Maslahat uchun → SHOULD.

Ijobiy maslahat, chunki ko'z shifokoriga borish
FOYDALI ish.

'must' bo'lmaydi — bu majburiyat emas, do'stona
maslahat.

'an optician' = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik.

tasks.prompt: a) giving advice —  A: I feel tired.  B: You ............ go to bed so late.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving ADVICE' → should/shouldn't.

Bu yerda SALBIY maslahat: kech yotish CHARCHOQQA
sabab bo'ladi.

DIQQAT: 'You should go to bed' bo'lsa ma'no
boshqa — 'hozir uxlang'. Lekin gap KELAJAKDA
kech yotmaslik haqida, shuning uchun SHOULDN'T.

'so late' = shunchalik kech.

tasks.prompt: b) giving permission —  A: ............... I use your phone, please?
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving PERMISSION' (ruxsat).
Ruxsat SO'RASH uchun → CAN I ...?

'Must I use your phone?' — ma'nosiz
(majburiyat emas, iltimos).

'please' ham iltimos ekanini ko'rsatib turibdi.

Rasmiyroq: 'MAY I ...?' yoki 'COULD I ...?'

tasks.prompt: b) giving permission —  B: Yes, of course you ............... .
tasks.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN I ...?'  →  'Yes, you CAN.'

'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi
(101-betdagi 12-mashqda ham shunday edi:
'Yes, of course you can.').

Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi:
'Yes, you can.' ✓
'Yes, you can use my phone.' (ortiqcha)

tasks.prompt: c) expressing obligation —  A: Do I have to wash the dishes?  B: Yes, you do! You ............... wash the dishes — it's your turn!
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'expressing OBLIGATION'
(majburiyat) → MUST.

Savolda 'DO I HAVE TO', javobda 'YOU MUST' —
101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan AYNAN bir xil naqsh:
  SA: 'Do I have to make the bed?'
  SB: 'Yes, you do. You must make the bed.'

'it's your turn' — majburiyatning sababi.
'to wash the dishes' = idish yuvmoq.

tasks.prompt: d) refusing permission —  A: Mum, ............... I have some sweets?
tasks.whyUz:
Bola onasidan RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?

Sarlavha 'REFUSING permission' — ya'ni ruxsat
BERILMAYDI, lekin SAVOL baribir 'Can I ...?'
shaklida bo'ladi.

'to HAVE sweets' = shirinlik yemoq
('have' bu yerda 'yemoq' ma'nosida).

tasks.prompt: d) refusing permission —  B: No, you ............... . They're bad for your teeth.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'REFUSING permission'
(ruxsat bermaslik) → CAN'T.

Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
  'CAN I ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'

DIQQAT — NEGA 'MUSTN'T' EMAS:
Bu ONANING shaxsiy qarori, QONUN emas.
'mustn't' qonuniy taqiq uchun (e-dialogga
qarang).

'teeth' — 'tooth' ning ko'pligi
(tooth → TEETH, noto'g'ri ko'plik).

tasks.prompt: e) expressing prohibition —  A: Can I park here?  B: No, you can't. You ............... park here — it's illegal.
tasks.promptUz: Bu yerga mashina qo'yish mumkin emas — bu qonunga xilof.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'expressing PROHIBITION'
(taqiq) → MUSTN'T.

ENG MUHIM FARQ — d) va e):
  d) CAN'T   — ONA ruxsat bermayapti
               (shaxsiy qaror)
  e) MUSTN'T — QONUN taqiqlagan
               ('it's ILLEGAL')

Shuning uchun bu yerda avval 'you can't'
deyilib, keyin 'you MUSTN'T' bilan
KUCHAYTIRILADI.

DIQQAT — PHOTO FILE:
  Xolasining xati kitobning PHOTO FILE bo'limida
  (kitob oxirida). U bizdagi skanda YO'Q,
  shuning uchun uning aniq matni bu yerda
  keltirilmadi — taxmin qilinmadi.

  Quyida vazifaning TUZILIShI va TO'LIQ NAMUNA
  javob berilgan.


VAZIFANING MOHIYATI:
  Photo File dagi xat QISQARTMA shaklda
  (eslatma-ro'yxat) yozilgan.
  Sizning vazifangiz — uni TO'LIQ GAPLARGA
  aylantirish.

  Masalan:
     QISQA:  'not too many hamburgers'
     TO'LIQ: 'You shouldn't eat too many
              hamburgers.'


QANDAY GAPLAR IShLATILADI:
  6-mashqdagi maslahat shakllari:
     You should ...
     You shouldn't ...
     Why don't you ... ?
     I think it's a good idea to ...
     I don't think it's a good idea to ...


XAT TUZILIShI (norasmiy, qarindoshga):

  1-xatboshi — SALOM va SABAB
     Dear Steve,
     Thanks for your letter. You asked me how to
     keep fit and healthy, so here is my advice.

  2-xatboshi — OVQAT (nima YEYISh kerak)
     You should eat a lot of fruit and
     vegetables, and I think it's a good idea to
     have cereal with milk for breakfast.
     Also, you should drink a lot of water.

  3-xatboshi — NIMA QILMASLIK kerak
     You shouldn't eat too many hamburgers or
     pizzas, and I don't think it's a good idea
     to eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream.
     You shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer,
     either.

  4-xatboshi — MAShQ va XAYRLAShUV
     Why don't you take regular exercise? You
     should walk to work, too — it's good for
     you and for the environment.
     Write back soon and tell me how you are
     getting on.

     Love,
     Aunt Mary


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT (bir butun holda):

  Dear Steve,

  Thanks for your letter. You asked me how to
  keep fit and healthy, so here is my advice.

  You should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables,
  and I think it's a good idea to have cereal
  with milk for breakfast. Also, you should drink
  a lot of water.

  You shouldn't eat too many hamburgers or
  pizzas, and I don't think it's a good idea to
  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream. You
  shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer, either.

  Why don't you take regular exercise? You should
  walk to work, too — it's good for you and for
  the environment.

  Write back soon and tell me how you are getting
  on.

  Love,
  Aunt Mary

EMAS. Kitobdagi Photo File xatida boshqa
bandlar bo'lishi mumkin. 6-mashqdagi sakkiz
band asosida tuzilgan.

  Boshlanishi:  Dear Steve,

  'You shouldn't drink beer, EITHER.'
  Inkor gapda 'ham' ma'nosi — 'TOO' emas,
  'EITHER'.
     Tasdiq:  'I like it, TOO.'
     Inkor:   'I don't like it, EITHER.'

YOZISh QUTISI — VARAQA QOIDALARI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA (to'liq):
  'When we write LEAFLETS giving rules,
   regulations, advice, instructions, etc,
   we write ONE RULE AFTER THE OTHER on
   SEPARATE LINES. We use the IMPERATIVE and
   words like NEVER, ALWAYS, MAKE SURE, etc.
   We may also give the REASON why we should
   do what the rule says.'

  KITOBDAGI MISOL:
     'Never light fires in forests.
      Trees will burn.'


VARAQANING BESH XUSUSIYATI:

  1  HAR QOIDA ALOHIDA QATORDA
     (one rule after the other on separate
      lines)

  2  BUYRUQ MAYLI (imperative)
     — ega yo'q: 'Wear a hat.'

  3  KUCHAYTIRUVChI SO'ZLAR:
        NEVER      — hech qachon
        ALWAYS     — doim
        MAKE SURE  — ishonch hosil qiling
        DON'T      — ...mang

  4  SABAB BERILADI (ixtiyoriy)
     'Never light fires in forests.
      TREES WILL BURN.'

  5  Qisqa va aniq gaplar


BU QOIDA 99-BETDAGI VARAQADA IShLATILGAN:
  'HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT'
     • Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
       The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
     • Use less washing-up liquid.
       It pollutes the seas and rivers.
     ...

  Ko'ryapsizmi — har bandda QOIDA + SABAB,
  alohida qatorda.

  'MAKE SURE you wear a hat.'
  = shlyapa kiyishni unutmang

   the door.'

  a leaflet     = varaqa, buklet
  a regulation  = nizom, qoida
  separate      = alohida
  a line        = qator
  the imperative = buyruq mayli
